title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Documented Saint Anselm traditions spanning the Hilltop’s academic, seasonal, service, nursing, and literary life.

cards.title: See Your Class Banner in Davison
cards.subtitle: Davison Hall · a Saint Anselm class-year marker
cards.notes: Find your class banner in Davison Hall, then return during commencement week to see this long-running class-year marker reach its final chapter.
cards.short_summary: Each class’s banner hangs in Davison Hall until commencement week.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm identifies the hanging of class banners in Davison Hall until commencement week as one of its favorite traditions.
cards.access_notes: Davison Hall access follows current campus building policies.

cards.title: Enter the Gingerbread House Competition
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College · annual holiday tradition
cards.notes: Form a team and watch for the seasonal entry announcement; plan your design around the contest’s current rules, deadline, and display arrangements.
cards.short_summary: An annual student competition turns gingerbread construction into a Hilltop holiday ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm lists entering the annual Gingerbread House Competition among its favorite campus traditions.
cards.access_notes: Offered seasonally; confirm current entry details through campus announcements.

cards.title: Take Part in Relay For Life
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College · annual fundraising tradition
cards.notes: Join or support a registered team through the current campus Relay For Life effort, and use the official event information for participation details.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus fundraiser links student participation with the American Cancer Society’s Relay For Life.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm describes Relay For Life as a tradition through which participants raise more than $100,000 annually.
cards.access_notes: Registration and fundraising expectations depend on the current event.

cards.title: Share the Christmas Feast
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College · seasonal dining tradition
cards.notes: Check the end-of-semester dining calendar and attend with friends when the feast is scheduled; dining access and menu details are announced each year.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal communal meal brings students together as the fall term closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm names dining with friends during the Christmas Feast as a favorite campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal event; confirm date, venue, and dining eligibility in current announcements.

cards.title: Read a Sonnet for Shakespeare
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College · annual April reading
cards.notes: Volunteer for a reading slot or stop by the celebration to hear sonnets and performances; consult the English Department’s current event notice.
cards.short_summary: Saint Anselm marks Shakespeare’s birthday with a campus reading of all 154 sonnets.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm documents an annual Shakespeare’s Birthday Celebration that grew from a 1989 reading of all 154 sonnets.
cards.source_title: Annual Shakespeare's Birthday Celebration | Saint Anselm College
cards.access_notes: Held around Shakespeare’s birthday; reader sign-up and format vary by year.

cards.title: Witness the Blessing of the Hands
cards.subtitle: Abbey Church · undergraduate nursing tradition
cards.notes: Nursing students and their guests can follow the annual ceremony notice, which honors sophomores as they prepare to begin their first clinicals.
cards.short_summary: Professors bless sophomore nursing students’ hands before their first clinical experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm calls the Blessing of the Hands a beloved undergraduate nursing tradition held in the Abbey Church.
cards.source_title: 2026 Blessing of the Hands | Saint Anselm College
cards.access_notes: The 2026 ceremony welcomed friends and family; verify future ceremony details with Nursing.

cards.title: Celebrate at Nurse Pinning
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College · nursing milestone
cards.notes: For eligible nursing students and invited guests, follow the Jean School’s commencement-season communications for the ceremony’s current date and format.
cards.short_summary: A nursing-program ceremony recognizes graduates as they enter the profession.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm lists Nurse Pinning among the additional opportunities and traditions available to its nursing students.
cards.access_notes: Intended for nursing graduates and their invited guests; event arrangements vary annually.

cards.title: Start With Brian Maguire Day of Service
cards.subtitle: New Student Orientation · Saint Anselm College
cards.notes: New students should follow orientation assignments and service-site instructions for this annual opening-week opportunity to work with community partners.
cards.short_summary: New students begin their Anselmian experience with a coordinated day of service.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm states that its annual Brian Maguire Day of Service is part of new-student orientation.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation | Saint Anselm College
cards.access_notes: For new students; service locations, transportation, and requirements are provided during orientation.

cards.title: Look for the Holiday Fair
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College · seasonal campus tradition
cards.notes: Watch Student Affairs and campus-event listings for the current fair date, location, vendors, and any participation details before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal campus event named among the college’s longstanding traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm includes Holiday Fair in its published list of college traditions.
cards.access_notes: Offered seasonally; confirm whether the event is open to visitors and any current requirements.

cards.title: Join New Student Orientation
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College · first-year welcome tradition
cards.notes: Complete the required orientation schedule, including academic and Anselmian-life sessions, and use official communications for move-in and program details.
cards.short_summary: The annual welcome program introduces incoming students to Saint Anselm’s academic and community life.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm includes Freshman Orientation among its traditions and publishes annual new-student orientation programming.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation | Saint Anselm College
cards.access_notes: Designed for incoming students and their families; dates and required sessions are published annually.
